purpose: Teach: 逆襲/脱落/総統/総督/ゆだね/波乱/バイパス/リバウンド

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪組織への逆襲捜査もされますね
lines.en: The police do counterinvestigations against criminal organizations, don't they?
lines.style: Conversational, slightly questioning tone. Observational rhythm, like listing facts you've noticed. Light, curious inflection on the final particle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、訓練生の脱落者支援もされますね
lines.en: The police also support trainees who drop out of the academy, I understand?
lines.style: Gentle, almost thoughtful. Softer attack. Wondering aloud rather than asking aggressively. Slight pause before the final confirmation particle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新総統就任時の警備もされますね
lines.en: The police handle security for the new president's inauguration as well, right?
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact tone. Even pacing. Like moving through a checklist of observations. Natural emphasis on the scope of their work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、植民地時代の総督記録も整理されますね
lines.en: And they also organize records from the colonial period, I imagine?
lines.style: Quieter here, more hesitant. Less certain of this one. Smaller vocal energy. Genuine curiosity mixed with slight uncertainty.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場対応を若手にゆだねる事もありますね
lines.en: The police sometimes trust younger officers with on-scene response, don't they?
lines.style: Warm, approving undertone. Recognition in the voice. Clear, direct phrasing. Pride in acknowledging competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市内の波乱含みの抗議活動を警備されますね
lines.en: They also provide security for sometimes contentious protests around the city, right?
lines.style: More serious now. Steady backbone to the delivery. Measured pacing. Acknowledgment of complexity without judgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、緊急車両のバイパス通行訓練もされますね
lines.en: The police conduct training drills for emergency vehicles using bypass routes as well?
lines.style: Back to straightforward observation. Factual, methodical tone. Even, administrative cadence. Like noting another item on a list.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、再犯のリバウンドを抑制されますね
lines.en: And they work to suppress the reoffending cycle, don't they?
lines.style: Warmer, more sincere. Closer emotional distance to the speaker. Recognition of preventive work. Affirming tone, like nodding in agreement.
